title: Independent cattle slaughterers protest privatized cattle-yard activity
possible_owner: Djibouti 2023-04; May report says protests had continued since April and arrests/summons occurred in late April and early/mid-May
notes: The May19 issue describes protests since April but does not give a precise start date or participant headcount; it does not independently validate the April10 >60-arrest report as a crowd count. Treat as continuity evidence, not a new May episode.
